how.title: One deal a day
how.text: A new deal opens every morning at 6am ET and closes 24 hours later. The shelf extras stay open all week.

note.title: The sale I run once a year,
body: Every November I put the courses I actually teach from on sale for one week. This year there's a new membership, a new kit, and the last chance to get the Studio Pass for life.
If there's a course you've been circling all year, this is the week. Each deal gets its own day, and once it closes it's gone until next year.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about Juniper Week

items.q: When does each deal open and close?
items.a: Each daily deal opens at 6am ET and closes 24 hours later. The shelf extras are open the whole week.

items.q: What time is that where I live?
items.a: The countdown at the top of the page shows the exact time left in your own time zone.

items.q: Can I buy more than one deal?
items.a: Yes. Each deal is a separate checkout, so buy as many as you like while they're open.
Every course has a 14-day refund window. Email the studio and it's handled the same day.

closing.title: The best week of the year
closing.text: Circle the deals that fit where your work is heading next year, and come back each morning when they open.
